response.sql: SELECT SUM(n) AS total_rentals FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM rental WHERE CAST(return_date AS CHAR) BETWEEN '2005-07-13 08:35:51' AND '2005-08-09 05:58:16' GROUP BY customer_id) AS per_customer;

assumptions.assumption: The database is MySQL, as the sakila-style schema suggests, so CAST(return_date AS CHAR) yields 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' text that compares correctly as a string.
BETWEEN is inclusive at both endpoints, and rentals with NULL return_date are excluded because they cannot match.
